title: consolidation skips when nothing changed

setup.note: Two active spaces with the same label (a pair the pair judge WOULD be asked about) and a closed episode. The last hourly roll happened after every write — an hour with no writes.

input_events: The hourly roll fires with nothing written since the last roll.
Then one episode is written into sp_a and the roll fires again.

wrong.label: clock-driven-call
wrong.assert_absent: a pair-judge call made on a store with no row written since the last roll

wrong.label: silent-merge
wrong.assert_absent: a merge applied by the machine
